resources.string: After X3DH both users run the Double Ratchet. Every message moves a chain forward to a fresh key, and every reply mixes in a new Diffie-Hellman step. Old keys are deleted, so a stolen phone does not reveal earlier messages.
User 2 can reply after the first message
Send a few messages from one side, then reply from the other
DH step: the receiver got a new ratchet key, so both root and chains changed
Chain step: same ratchet key, the next message key in the chain
